tei:div.tei:p: (ma)༄༅// 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ 'phags pa yon tan 'od/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa rnams kyi rtogs brjod bzhugs// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ dpal bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa nges don nyin mor byed pa'i snang bas snying gi mun pa sangs byed ces bya ba/ chos dbyings zhi ba'i nags su rtag bzhugs nas// 'gro kun mtshan ma'i lam las bsrung bya'i phyir// rten 'brel sgyu mar 'char ba'i gsung dbyangs kyis// thub bstan nyi mor mdzad la phyag bgyi'o// byis blos btags pa'i bden don rnam gnyis po// thad sor bzhag nas blang dor spyod pa'i chos// smon lam mthar phyin gzhan don sku gnyis po'i// lam ston mdzangs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten lugs kyi don dam ji snyed pa// brdzun pa'i yul dang ngo bos stong pa'i tshul// rnam par bshad nas nges par legs pa'i lam// 'chad mdzad mkhas pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa'i don dam de kun yang dag pa'i// kun rdzob ces byar bshad nas chos rnams kun// brjod bral tshul gyis chos sku'i lam chen po// gsal mdzad dpa' bo de la phyag 'tshal lo// dang por bdag dang bar du bdag med dang*// tha mar spros bral 'chad pa'i rim pa yis// 'khor mang bsdus dang smin dang grol mdzad nas// ston pa'i bstan pa bzung la phyag 'tshal lo// rgya chen spyod pa'i phyogs rnams ma lus dang*// bden bzhi'i tshul dang pha rol phyin tshul dang*// tshul chen gsum ka stong nyid kha lo yis// bsgyur mdzad khyu mchog de la phyag 'tshal lo// tshul gsum chos dang spros bral chos lugs la// ji bzhin mkhas pa'i 'og tu 'phags rnams la// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa'i pha rol du// phyin tshul gsung ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam shes yul du mtshan ma gang shar ba// ltos nas grub phyir ye shes yul du ni// ngo bos stong phyir snang stong zung 'jug zhes// ston mdzad tshad ma'i skyes bu la phyag 'tshal// bsod nams sgo chen sngon du ma phye na// stong nyid gtam gyis chad mthar lhung srid phyir// 'jig rten chos lugs bde 'gro'i lam dag tu// ston mdzad thabs mkhas de la phyag 'tshal lo// bar du bdag med bdud rtsis ma sbyangs na// legs byas ji snyed 'jig rten lam 'gyur phyir// rnam thar sgo bzhi 'jig rten 'das lam du// 'khrid mdzad smra mkhas de la phyag 'tshal lo// brjod bral lam gang sngon du ma btang na// lung ston gtam gyis bdag tu rtog srid phyir// spros bral shes nas sems kyi rdo rje yang*// ji bzhin ston mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems kyi rdo rje chos dbyings ye shes dang*// don dam byang sems sangs rgyas snying po dang*// gnas bdun gyis bstan rdo rje rnam bdun yang*// bstod pa'i tshogs su khyod kyis gsal bar bshad// gnyis med ye shes kho na chos dbyings dang*// don dam byang sems yin par khyod kyis bshad// spros pa'i tshogs rnams bkag tsam chos dbyings dang*// sgrib kun sbyang gzhi yin par khyod mi bzhed// gnas skabs gsum du khyad par med zhugs pa'i// rang rig ye shes don dam bden par bshad// don dam gang yin spros mtha' bkag tsam du// nges par 'chad pa khyod kyi gzhung ma yin// zag med ye shes bde gshegs snying po dang*// sems kyi rdo rjer 'chad pa khyod kyi lugs// rang sems stong rkyang sangs rgyas snying po dang*// rdo rjer 'chang ba khyod kyi gzhung ma yin// 'od gsal zhes bya rtog pas ma sbags pa'i// phyogs su ma chad rig pa'i cha la bshad// rang bzhin bkag pa'i med par dgag pa tsam// 'od gsal zhes bya'i don du khyod mi bzhed// rang bzhin 'od gsal gzhi lam 'bras gsum la// khyad par med pa chos sku'i dgongs gzhir bshad// 'gro kun chos sku'i snying po can yin zhes// gsal bar 'chad pa khyod kyi gzhung ma yin// dri mas bsgribs pa'i chos dbyings sems can dang*// sgrib bral chos dbyings sangs rgyas yin par bshad// sems can kun kyang sangs rgyas yin no zhes// gsal bar 'chad pa khyod kyi gzhung ma yin// gsal rig tsam gyi mtha' dbus bral ba la// rtag dang 'dus ma byed par khyod kyis bshad// 'dus ma byed phyir ye shes min no zhes// bcom sgrogs dbyangs su sgrogs pa khyod gzhung min// chos dbyings ye shes rtag brtan zhi ba dang*// g.yung drung yin par byams pa'i chos las 'byung*// skye 'jig med pa'i rtag brtan du bsams nas// chos dbyings rig par mi 'chad khyod mi bzhed// gzhi yi dus su bdag du rmongs pa'i gzhi// lam gyi dus su gnyis med ye shes dang*// 'bras bu'i dus su dri bral chos kyi sku// kun kyang zag med ye shes nyag gcig yin// rang gi ngo bo rang bzhin gyis dag kyang*// ji srid sgrib las ma grol de srid du// mtha' yas yon tan tshogs rnams yod mi srid// stobs sogs chos dang nyes tshogs lhan cig 'gal// dri med tshogs rnams de dang lhan cig tu// yun ring 'grogs kyang de dang 'dres pa med// stobs sogs yon tan de yi rang bzhin du// 'dres par 'gyur 'di rnam dbyer med pa'i don// chu klung rgya mtshor gnas pa min mod kyang*// rgya mtshor son na kun kyang dbyer med 'gyur// stobs sogs yon tan gdod nas yod min kyang*// dri mas dag tshe chos dbyings nyid du 'gyur// rang bzhin rnam dag chos sku'i dgongs gzhi dang*// sgrib kun 'bral rung rtogs pa dgos pa dang*// gnod byed sbun pas g.yogs pa'i swa ba la// sa lir mi brjod dpe yis gsal bar

chos dbyings bstod par/ bsnyad// rang bzhin chos sku sangs rgyas dngos yin na// rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs dang sbrul pa'i sku// gzhan don mthar phyin sku dang de blo yang*// thams cad gzigs blo yin par khas longs shig /lam chen lnga dang tshogs gnyis ma rdzogs shing*// sku gsum ye shes rnam bzhi ma tshang ba'i// rang bzhin chos sku de bzhin gshegs yin na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du khas longs shig /'gro kun rdzogs sangs rgyas na de dag la// sangs rgyas snying po med par 'gal zhe na// chu shing snying po kho na mi gnas kyang*// 'bras bu dngar po kun gyis spyad byar 'gyur// de bzhin 'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po can// min yang rgyu mthun 'bras bu 'byung ngo zhes// chos dbyings bstod par klu sgrub zhabs nyid kyis// gsal bar bshad pa'i dgongs pa gang yin smros// klu sgrub zhabs dang thogs med mched gnyis kyang*// chos dbyings ye shes sangs rgyas snying po dang*// rang bzhin gnas rigs yin par 'chad pa'i tshul// mi mthun med de rang rang gzhung na rgyud bla dang chos dbyings bstod pa/ gsal// byams pa'i gzhung na chos kyis dbyings zhes pa// med dgag kho nar 'chad pa'i gsal kha med// dri bcas de bzhin nyid de zag bcas kyi// ye shes kho nar 'chad pa de gzhung yin// klu sgrub gzhung du tha mar spros pa kun// bzlog pa'i tshe na chos kyi dbyings zhes pa// yod med la sogs spros pa'i mtha' bsal nas// ngos bzung med par 'chad pa'i skabs shig snang*// de tshe spros pa'i mtha' kun bral de la// chos dbyings ye shes sangs rgyas snying po dang*// rang bzhin rigs tshogs su/ gnas rigs sems kyi rdo rje sogs// nges don tha snyad mang po der mi 'dogs// tha snyad de dag spros bral chos la ni/ bstod tshogs su/ /nges pa rnyed nas phyir mi ldog pa'i gtam// gang la bsnyad pa theg chen 'phags pa'i tshogs// byang chub mchog tu lung ston skabs de yin// bdag dang bdag med spros bral rim pa yis// rnam dpyod bzang por byas pa'i 'og rol du// dam pa'i bdag dang sems kyi rdo rje la// gang brten thegs mchog gsung khyod phyag gi gnas// gang la bstod nas gang gi lugs bzang po// legs par bshad la legs tshogs ci mchis pa// mtha' yas 'gro ba mtha' dag srid zhi las// rnam par grol ba'i rnam mkhyen don du bsngo// ces pa 'di yang*/

klu sgrub zhabs kyi bdud rtsi'i zim char blo gros kyi dpag bsam la nye bar sim pa'i spong ba pa 'jam dpal dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// swasti/ 'phags pa lha'i zhal mnga' nas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ de nyid kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// siṅgha la'i yul rgyal po yi// thugs kyi sras gyur de nyid kyi// skyed tshal yid 'ongs 'dab brgya pa'i// lte bar brdzus te 'khrungs khyod ni// 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sangs rgyas kyis// lung bstan so skye'i dus nyid nas// spyan yang slong la btang bzod pas// 'phags pa'i mtshan thob rgyal sras lha// mngal skyes gzhan gyis mi 'dul ba'i// mchog sbyin thob pa'i mu stegs can// dregs can sangs rgyas bstan pa la// 'jug mdzad kun gyis bkur khyod ni// klu sgrub sras kyi mchog gyur nas// phyi mor gyur pa'i gzhung brtsams pa// 'phags pa'i gzhung bzhin sras kun gyis// bsngags pas snyan grags bde thob pa// khyod kyis mthar 'dzin drungs 'byin tshe// rigs tshogs lhur blangs nyams len gyi// snying po ye shes la gzhol ba'i// bstan bcos bzhi brgya pa de yi// srol chen thog mar chos skyong gis// rab bzung phyi dus zhi ba 'tsho// sras dang bcas pas dar mdzad la// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma grags// chos skyong gis ni gzhung brtsams pa// sems tsam lugs yin lhag pa'i lhas// rjes bzung ngo bo nyid med du// gnas gyur zhes pa rang 'ga'i tshig /yin no shes byed phyi dus 'dir// ngo bo nyid med smra gzhung las// gzhan pa'i dbu ma med smra ba// de rjes 'jug pa'i gtam bcal po// yin no shes byed chos skyong gis// thog mar gsang sngags gang zhig ni// nyams su blangs pas lha gang gzigs// rjes su bir+wa par gyur tshe// man ngag gzhung chen gang mdzad pa// de dang de ni dbu ma yi// lta sgom gang dang gang yod pa// de dang de 'dir khyod kyis smros// pha rol phyin pa'i lta ba dang*// na snyam byas nas zung 'jug gi

/ye shes sgom byar bshad snyam byed// 'dir yang sems tsam yin zhes dang*// gzhan 'ga' zhig ni spros med sogs// thal rang gzhung bzhin yin zer ba'i// mgo 'khor spangs nas gdeng thob byos// ye shes snying po kun las btus// mdzad po 'phags pa lha 'di yis// ye shes dam pa'i don nyid du// med par bshad pa ci zhe na// sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i shes pa'i ngor// ci yang yod pa ma yin dang*// rang rig ye shes spyod yul la// nyams len byed ces ma smras sam// sgro 'dogs gang bcad sgom pa yi// nyams len dgos pa sangs rgyas kyi// dgongs pa yin na dri med 'od// sgron gsal bcas la khyod kyis rgol// klu sgrub gzhung lugs gsang sngags dang*// sbyor tshe ār+ya de wa dang*// bir+wa pas bshad de las ni// gzhan du btsal bya ma yin pa'i// dbang po grub pa'i sar gzhug pa'i// rnam 'grel mkhan dang zhi ba 'tsho// pad+ma'i ngang tshul ye shes zhabs// de sogs sngags gzhung mdzad kun no// 'phags pa lha 'dis phyi dus su// gsang ba 'dus pa'i nyams len gyis// sa brgyad pa la bzhugs so zhes// tshad ldan mang po'i gsung las 'byung*// 'dis mdzad spyod bsdus sgron sogs na// thal rang gzhung du ma grags pa'i// sgyu ma dang ni 'od gsal dang*// zung 'jug lta ba'i rim pa yang*// rgyas par bshad do de dag kun// rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i// bzhed pa yin pa yod min phyir// de yang sems tsam lugs su smros// rang byin rlabs las phyir phyogs pas// rmi lam sgyu 'dra mi rtogs zhes// gang des bshad do dbu ma la// 'jug pa las brgal lta ba 'di// sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i// dbu ma las byung 'di yang ni// sems tsam yin zhes khyed cag gis// spobs pa bskyed nas smra nus sam// mdor na klu sgrub 'phags pa lha'i// dgongs pa zla bas gsal 'jug tu// bshad las gzhan du med ces pa// mkhas pa rnams kyi mi smra'i gtam// 'di bshad pa las byung ba yi// dge ba gangs can ri bo'i rtser// bde 'byung gtsug rgyan 'phos 'dra ba// de yis rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog/

//maṅga laṃ// ༄༅// na mo ār+ya mai tri nā tha ye/ 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa ngas don zla zer dkar po'i phreng bas snying gi gdung ba 'phrog byed ces bya ba/ ji lta'i don la 'phags pa'i thugs mnga' zhing*/ ji snyed 'chad la thogs pa med pa'i gsung*// ji ltar bzhed bzhin byams mgon gzigs pa'i sku// ji skad gsungs bzhin 'dzin la phyag bgyi'o// mi pham zhal gyi bdud rtsi gsol ba las// dbu sems shing rta'i srol chen gnyis gzigs nas// theg chen chos kyi nges don gsal mdzad pa// brtse chen mkhyen pa'i gter la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan nyid gsum dang bden pa rnam gnyis dang*// bdag med gnyis dang kun gzhi'i chos lugs kyis// theg chen gsung rab ma lus gsal mdzad pa'i// shing rta'i srol 'byed de la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos gcig du mar snang ba'i gtan tshigs kyis// phyi rol don gzhan med par thag bcad nas// snang ba sems su sgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyis// dbu mar 'khrid mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// bzung ba med na de 'dzin med pa yis// rigs pas gzung 'dzin rang stong yin pa'i tshul// legs par bshad nas gnyis med don dam du// ston mdzad 'jigs med de la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med ye shes stong par mi 'chad kyang*// kun rdzob mtha' bzhi'i spros bral khas blangs nas// lhag med myang 'das theg chen lam nyid du// 'jug tshul 'doms pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum dang zag med ye shes dang*// byang chub yon tan sangs rgyas phrin las rnams// don dam ye shes rdo rjer gsal mdzad nas// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa'i chos lugs kyang*// ji bzhin 'chad mkhas de la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod gzhung las byung shing rta'i srol gnyis po// gangs can 'di na log par bshad mthong nas// nyid gzhung ji bzhin rtog pa'i rnam dpyod kyis// gzhan la ma grags don 'ga' 'dir bshad bya// bden bzhi'i chos dang stong nyid chos tshul dang*// don dam rnam nges chos kyi tshul gsum po// nges don yin lugs ston par chos mtshungs kyang*// dgongs pa'i dbang gis grangs nges rnam par phye// bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas stong pa yi// gnyis med ye shes gang zag bdag med kyi// don du ston byed 'khor lo dang po yi// dgongs don gang yin tha mas gsal bar bshad// 'khor lo dang por bden pa gnyis bstan pa// kun rdzob ji bzhin sgra dang don dam ni// ldem po'i ngag gis bstan phyir drang ba'i don// phyi rol don dang de 'dzin gyis stong pa'i// gnyis med ye shes chos kyi bdag med kyi// don du ston byed 'khor lo gnyis pa yi// dgongs don gang yin 'khor lo tha mas bshad// nges don mthar thug 'khor lo gnyis par ni// gnyis stong bshad kyang gnyis med don dam du// ji bzhin sgra yis gsal por ma bshad pas// bla na mchis dang drang ba'i don zhes bya// 'khor lo tha mar gnyis med ye shes ni// don dam yin pa ji bzhin sgra yis bshad// der bshad de las lhag pa'i nges don ni// med phyir bla na ma mchis nges pa'i don// don dam mthar thug gnyis med ye shes ni// 'khor lo bar pa'i bstan bya'i gtso bor bshad// 'khor lo bar pa drang don yin no zhes// 'chad pa de ni thogs med bzhed gzhung min// drang nges khyad par brjod byas mi 'byed par// lugs 'dir brjod byed kho nas 'byed do zhes// zer ba rnam bshad rigs pa'i gzhung dang ni// theg chen bsdus pa'i sdom dang 'gal bar nges// stong pa'i tshul la nges pa rnyed kyi bar// nges don ldem po'i ngag gis ma bstan na// gnyis med ye shes bdag tu 'khrul srid pas// 'khor lo bar pa ji bzhin min pa'i sgra// med dang yod dang rang bzhin stong nyid kyi// rnam gzhag shes nas kun gzhi'i ye shes dang*// gnyis med ye shes bde gshegs snying po sogs// nges don de dag bdag dang bden par bshad// ye shes de nyid spros pa kun bral zhing*// smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das gyur kyang*// rang rig ye shes chen pos rig bya'i phyir// dam pa'i bdag dang bden pa'i dngos por nges// bden par grub kyang spros pa'i yul min phyir// de la mtshan 'dzin shes bya'i sgrib par bshad// rnam g.yeng rnam rtog rnam bcu gzhan gyi dbang*// de yis gang brtags kun du btags par bshad// de nyid de yis stong pa yongs su grub// gzhan la gang grags de dag gzhung na med// sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan yod min zhing*// gnyis med ye shes sems kyi ngo bor bshad// de phyir sems kyi ngo bo mi stong yang*// bzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong de grub pa'i mtha'// kun btags rang stong gzhan dbang gzhan stong dang*// yongs grub stong pa'i dngos dang gzhan dbang gi

/ngo bor bshad nas spros kun 'byung ba'i gzhir// 'chad pa de ni rnal 'byor spyod gzhung yin// gzhan dbang bden grub yin par khas blangs na// gzung 'dzin gnyis stong 'byung ba'i go skabs med// de med rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rgya mtsho yi// nges don mthar thug snying po gang nas tshol// gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan khegs tsam kun btags dag /rang stong yin par bshad pas shes par nus// gzhan dbang sgyu mar 'chad tshul ma shes na// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung rdzogs par 'chad mi nus// kun btags bden med gzhan dbang bden grub dang*// gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan khegs pa'i stong nyid la// yongs grub ces byar 'chad pa rnam bden gzhung*// sems tsam zhes bya'i grub pa'i mtha' de yin// gzhan dbang bden med yongs grub bden pa zhes// gsal bar bshad pas mtha' gnyis sel ba ni// rgyan dang rnam 'byed gnyis kyis sher phyin mdo// dbu mar bkral ba'i tshul lugs mchog de yin// de las gong na dbu mar grub pa'i mtha'// yod na dbang za'i lta bar 'gyur zhes bshad// de ltar shes na rnal 'byor spyod gzhung gi /ring lugs bla na med de rdzogs par mthong*// phyi rol don dang de yi gzung rnam la// gzung 'dzin kun btags zhes byar ngos bzung nas// gcig dang du mar med pa'i gtan tshigs kyis// gzung rnams bden par med pa dbu ma'i lam// gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo khas blangs kyang*// de yi ngo bo de ma yin pa'i phyir// gzhan dbang bden par grub pa'i lung ma yin// yod pa'i stong nyid ces bya gzhan gyi dbang*// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung grub mtha'i mthar thug tshe// gzung 'dzin gnyis ka kun du btags pa'i cha// gnyis med ye shes kho na don dam yin// de las logs na gzhan dbang nyag gcig kyang*// ngos bzung med na bden pa'i go skabs ci// snang ba sems dang gzhan dbang bden grub kyang*// sems tsam lugs yin dbu ma'i lugs nyid la// rnam rdzun zhes byar grags pa de gzhung min// bden grub ces bya don dam bden pa'i ming*// gzhan dbang spang byar 'chad pa grub pa'i mtha'// bden par grub nas spang byar ston pa yang*// theg chen gzhung lugs 'chad pa'i tshul ma yin// gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan bkag pa'i med dgag ni// ldog pa gzhan sel kun btags yin pa'i phyir// yongs grub yin pa'i lung dang rigs pa med// spyi mtshan bden grub chos kyi grags pas bkag

/zag bcas sa bon bsags pa kun gzhi ste// nges 'phangs rnam smin kun gzhi'i rnam shes yin// zag med sa bon gyur pa ye shes de// rang bzhin rigs dang sangs rgyas snying por bshad// 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi dang sa bon ni// zag pa med pa'i ye shes nyid kyis byas// de phyir kun gzhi'i ye shes rnam smin dang*// sa bon gsum gyis kun gzhi'i chos kun bsdus// sa bon zhes pa zag bcas kun gyi de// rnam smin zhes bya des bskyed lung ma bstan// gdod ma'i ye shes de nyid zag med kyi// sa bon yin phyir thos pa'i rkyen gyis gso// gso byed ma tshang mya ngan mi 'da' yang*// rang bzhin gnas rigs chad pa ga la srid// lhag med dbyings kyi kun gzhi'i ye shes kyang*// shes sgrib sa bon tshogs dang lhan cig gnas// ma rig bag chags sa dang zag med kyi// las kyis lus len zhes pa 'dir mi bzhed// lhag bcas theg pa chen por sems bskyed nas// dbang po'i lus gcig sa bcu'i mthar 'gro phyir// ji srid rdzogs sangs ma rgyas de srid du// kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa 'dor mi srid// nyan thos ma nges slob pa'i lam dag nas// theg chen lam zhugs smon lam mthu dang ni// sprul dang bsam mi khyab bsgyur 'chi 'pho yis// skye ba blangs te rdzogs sangs rgyas par gsungs// thogs med zhabs kyis theg chen rgyud bla ma// dbu mar bkral ba'i nges don mthar thug ni// gnas bdun gyis bstan rdo rje rnam bdun te// gnas skabs gsum gyi zag med ye shes mchog /sbyang gzhi dri bcas zag med ye shes ni// sbyong byed yongs sbyong drug bcu'i sgrub pa yis// rnam par sbyangs pas dri med ye shes ni// mngon du byed pa'i rim pa de gzigs so// dpal phreng gyis zhus mdo yi rjes 'brangs nas// lhag med dbyings kyi myang 'das ye shes kyang*// zag med las kyis mngon par mtshams sbyar nas// skye ba blangs te mngon par 'tshang rgya'o// gzhan stong tshul gyis spros bral ma gtogs pa// gnyis med ye shes rang gi ngo bo yis// stong par 'chad pa'i lung rigs 'dir ma gsungs// 'khor lo bar pa'i dgongs don 'chad pa na// yang dag mtha' de 'dus byas tshogs rnams kyis// rnam par dben pa'i gzhan stong gsal bar gsungs// sangs rgyas snying po glo bur dri ma yis// stong par 'chad cing bla med chos kyis ni// stong par mi 'chad de yang gzhan stong tshul// gsal bar 'chad pa'i 'grel pas legs par bshad// klu sgrub zhabs kyis skad cig la brtags pa'i// rigs pas brtags na de bzhin gshegs snying yang*// rnam par 'jig pa'i chos can yin mod kyi// 'gyur med du 'chad skabs 'dir de mi dpyod// klu sgrub rigs pa'i dpung tshogs mi bzod na// rtag brtan g.yung drung nyid du ji ltar 'gyur// de phyir dbyings de rtag brtan zhi ba dang*// g.yung drung nyid du 'chad pa de yin no// dbyings de ngo bos stong par ma bshad kyang*// de la mtshan 'dzin rtog pa yin pa'i phyir// zab gsal gnyis med ngang la mnyam gzhag blo// mtshan 'dzin bag chags dang bcas 'dis drungs 'byin// zag med ye shes de las 'gro kun dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi yon tan kun 'byung phyir// de nyid sems can khams dang sangs rgyas kyi// khams dang snying por bshad pa de yin no// dbyings de dgongs gzhir bzhag nas sems can kun// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi snying po can du bshad// rgyu yod pa la 'bras bu yod do zhes// btags pa'i dgos pa skyon lnga spang phyir te// dngos la gnod byed 'od dang 'od zer tshogs// rnam par spangs te nyi ma lta ba bzhin// sangs rgyas snying po rtag brtan du bshad pas// grangs can gyis brtags bdag tu 'gyur snyam na// de lan gsal po lang kar gshegs pa'i mdor// kun mkhyen nyid kyis gsal bar gsungs de yin// bdag dang bdag med spros pa nyer zhi la// dam pa'i bdag tu theg chen rgyud blar gsungs// bdag med pa nyid bdag nyid chen po'i bdag

/yin zhes theg chen mdo sde'i rgyan du 'byung*// bla med rdo rje'i theg pa'i gzhung dag tu// gnyis med ye shes de la 'od gsal dang*// don dam bden pa'i mchog tu bshad mang phyir// gang 'dir rtag brtan bshad la snyems mi dgos// rdo rje lta bu'i gnas bdun don dam gyi// bden par 'chad pa ha cang thal snyam na// dkon mchog gsum dang yon tan phrin las la// bden gnyis dbye ba thogs med zhabs kyi bzhed// khyad par dag la ma dag de bzhin nyid// byang chub sems dpar rtsa bas dngos su bstan// sangs rgyas pas bsdus kun rdzob bden pa ni// yod par 'chad pa'i theg chen tshul ma byung*// spang phyir bslu ba'i chos can sogs gsungs pa// mdo gzhan las 'byung dkon mchog rnam gnyis la// nye bar dgongs pa gong ma'i 'phros kyis shes// gzhung 'di'i skyabs gsum don dam bden par nges// thogs med zhabs kyi theg chen rgyud bla ma// thal 'gyur gzhung du bkral ba gad mo'i rgyu// mdo dang byams pa'i srol phye ma gtogs pa// bshad srol gzhan gyi rjes su 'di mi 'brang*// rgyal bas lung bstan sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srol// gzhan la ma rag nyid kyi rnam dpyod kyis// legs par bshad nas dbu ma'i lam chen po// 'khrul med 'doms pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thogs med thogs dang chags pa'i sgrib pa las// rnam grol rnam dpyod can gyis gang bshad pa// 'dir bshad 'dir ni dge ba gang yod des// bdag kyang bdag rtag gtsang bde'i gnas thob shog /ces 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyi bdud rtsi'i zil char blo gros kyi rgya mtshos nye bar 'thungs pa'i bsod snyoms pa/ mi pham dges pa'i bshes gnyen gyis dge bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //shu bhaṃ// ༄༅// na mo bud+dha ya/ ngo mtshar chos kyi yin lugs mthar thug pa// rab dgongs mdzad pas mkhyen pa'i rtse mor son// thugs rje'i dbang gyur 'gro ba thams cad kyi// bran bzhin mdzad pas phyag 'os shākya'i sras// sum rtsen dpa' bo rje btsun ma pham pas// nges don bdud rtsir mdzad pa'i 'chi med bcud// thub bstan sbrang rtsi'i dgra bo ma myangs pa// thogs med snyan shal ring po'i dpal du byon// theg gsum dpag bsam 'tsho ba'i rnam dpyod kyi// rtsa lag rab rgyas bstan bcos du ma'i bdag

/dbyig gnyen zhes byar grags pa'i rnga bo che// kun gyi rna bar sim mdzad de la 'dud// phyi dus 'di na khyod la mkhas mchog ces// gcam bu'i ngor byas brnyan brjod mang na yang*// blo ngan mang pos dngos smra'i 'dam du bcings// deng 'dir dag byed khrus kyi rgyun chen dbul// thub bstan 'bum phrag brgya yi mdzod bzung nas// nyin re bzhin yang nges don mchog cig pa'i// pha rol phyin gyur stong phrag brgya pa'i mdo// tshig zur ma nyams ljags rtser 'don pas gdon// mkhyen ldan khyod kyi gzhung rtsom skabs kyi tshe// nyan thos bstan pa phal cher dri mas sbags// theg chen bstan pa shar yang ma dar bar// gzigs nas theg gsum bstan bcos mang du mdzad// bden bzhi'i chos dang bden gnyis rnam dbye ba// thub bstan yongs kyi rtsa bar mkhyen gyur nas// grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i drang nges ma lus phye// 'dul ba'i lung dang nyan thos mdo sde'i gzhung*// grub mtha' smra bas mthun par 'dzin mod kyang*// mngon pa'i bstan bcos dri mas rnyogs gyur pa// lung dang rigs pas blang dor gsal bar mdzad// chos kyi bdag med phal cher mngon pa'i lugs// gang zag bdag med mdo sde'i gzhung bzhin du// gsal mdzad bstan bcos mngon pa'i mdzod chen de// nyi ma ji bzhin 'dzam gling kun la gsal// zhib mo'i mi bdag gsal bar ma bstan nas// chos kyi bdag med ji bzhin mtshon mi nus// de phyir khyod kyi 'dus byas chos kun la// gnas pa med par lung dang rigs pas bsgrubs// phra mo'i sdug bsngal ji bzhin ma bshad na// phyi nang thar pa'i khyad par dbye mi nus// de phyir khyod kyis byis pas sdug bsngal du// ma rtogs 'du byed sdug bsngal rgyas par bshad// rmongs chen 'khor ba'i rtsa bar ma bshad na// phyi nang lam gyi dbye ba mi phyed pas// rig byed gzhung du ma grags gang zag gi /bdag tu 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i rtsa bar bshad// de ltar bdag dang bdag gis stong lta ba'i// 'khrul med lam de su yi goms byas kyang*// thub pa'i bstan la rtsod pa dang bral ba'i// thar pa'i go 'phang rnyed par khyod kyis bshad// dman par nges pa'i nyan thos mang pos kyang*// bden bzhi'i chos lugs rgyas par shes pa na// skad cig gis mtshon chos kyi bdag med kyang*// shes mod gom byed min par khyod kyis bshad// 'di na la la dbyig gnyen gyis bshad pa'i// lam gyis thar pa'i go 'phang rnyed dka' zer// mdzod 'dir ma bshad gang zag bdag med pa// 'chad byed rigs pa sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs// rang rang gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgrib pa kun// de nas bshad pa'i gnyen pos mi sel na// rgyal bas dbang por 'tshams pa'i chos bstan pa// gzhung rtsom khyod kyis gsal bar bkral min nam// chos kyi bdag med gsal bar ma shes na// khams gsum nyon mongs spong nus min zhes pa'i// klan ka de yis khyod la rgol mi nus// skad cig gnas pa med par khyod kyis bshad// 'jig rten blo yi rnam dpyad mi bzod pa// kun rdzob chos su bshad par ma zad kyi// 'phags blos dpyad tshe rgyun dang rags pa'i dngos// ma lus ngo bos stong par khyod kyis bshad// bye smra'i gzhung la rtog ge'i blos brtags pa// mang zhig khyod kyis legs par bsal mdzad nas// bye brag smra gzhung thub bstan yid bzhin mtsho// 'degs byed gser gyi sa gzhi khyod kyis bshad// de nas theg chen bstan pa nor bu'i phreng*// rnam bshad rgyal mtshan rtse mor bzhugs gsol nas// dag byed rim gsum ldan pa'i sbyong tshul gyis// legs par sbyangs pa'i nges don khyod la mnga'// 'khor lo bar pa drang ba'i don nyid du// thogs med mched kyis 'chad ces 'di na grags// sher mdo'i dgongs pa nges pa'i don can du// blo bzang khyod kyis rnam bshad rig par gsungs// nges pa'i don zhig ngos 'dzin dgos gyur na// khyod dang klu sgrub lugs la khyad par med// thal rang gzhung gi dngos bstan ji bzhin pa// nges don ngos bzung med par che rnams bzhed// dgongs 'grel mdo dang khyod gzhung las bshad pa'i// chos dbyings ye shes nges pa'i don min na// rgyud gzhung kun dang 'dus pa'i rim lnga sogs// gang der bshad pa'i nges don su yis shes// de phyir theg chen sems bskyed thugs la 'khrungs// rgyud dang rgyud bla'i dgongs pa khyod kyis mkhyen// snang tshad sems su bden par khyod mi bzhed// dbu ma'i mtshan don ma lus khyod la mnga'// shes bya nang gir smra ba'i grub pa ni// theg mchog rtse mo yin te gang gi phyir// chos dbyings ma gtogs chos 'ga' yod min zhing*// chos dbyings de yang ye shes nyid phyir ro// chos dbyings ye shes rigs pas dpyad pa na// rigs ngor yod ma min yang 'phags chen blos// rtag tu gzigs phyir sems kyi rdo rje zhes// nges don gsung ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi rtogs brjod bstan pa la 'jug pa'i yid bzhin mdzod sgo zhes bya ba/

dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blos/ nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// // ༄༅// swasti/ dpal phyogs kyi glang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i gtam/ de nyid kyi gsung rab la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan phyogs rnams thams cad las// rgyal rnga lan brgyar brdungs rnams kyi// bstan pa'i brgya byin de 'dzin pa'i// nye dbang tshogs dang bcas rnams ni// sa gsum glang pos rnam dpyod dang*// rig pa'i brtsal gyis 'dir 'degs pa// thub pa'i dbang pos de mkhyen nas// rgyal ba'i sras por lung bstan pa// 'di de 'bigs byed nags su ni// mngon med gzhung brtsom la gzhol tshe// 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid mngon sum du// byon nas rjes bzung byin gyis brlabs// phyi ma'i dus su gzhung kun la// blta ba'i mig tu de 'gyur zhes// gzhung brtsom byed por rjes gnang bas// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur chen po// 'degs la ngal ba med khyod kyis// thog mar nyan thos sde pa'i gzhung*// 'khrul med mdo dang sbyar mdzad nas// sems tsam gzhung dang dbu ma yang*// chos 'khor gsum pa'i mdo bzhin bkral// khyad par du yang shing rta'i srol// gzhan la ma grags rig pa'i gnas// rang nyid gcig pu'i rnam dpyod kyis// brtsal ston mdzad pa tshad ma'i mdo// bstan pa'i bdag po thub pa nyid// mi bslu ma shes don gsal gyi// tshogs pas tshad mar gyur bsgrubs nas// des gsungs chos kyang 'khrul med kyi// lam du 'dren pa'i srol chen po// phyi nang rtog ge pa gzhan la// ma grags gtan tshigs rig pa'i sgo// nang don kun la 'jug 'di phye// rang phyogs sgrub la phyogs chos dang*// rjes 'gro tsam zhig kun la grags// rtags gang mi mthun phyogs las ni// bzlog tshul gzhan gyis ma bshad pa// med na mi 'byung 'brel nges pa// gzhan nas mi 'byung khyod kyis bshad// de las de 'byung 'brel tsam ni// blun pos kyang shes bdag gcig pa'i// 'brel pa shes pa'i rtsa ba ni// gzhan sel go las gzhan mi srid// tha dad nyid du su yis kyang*// ma mthong chos gcig sgra rtog gis// so sor phye las 'brel 'di bzhag

/de phyir dgag sgrub ji snyed pa// gzhan sel shes la rag las byung*// de phyir 'brel 'di ma shes na// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshad ma dang*// bstan pa'i snying po bdag med pa// sgrub dang de de'i log phyogs kyang*// sun 'byin ltar snang kho nar nges// de ltar de shes gyur 'og tu// rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras skye bar// grub dang rgyu sngon song du yang*// sgrubs pas tshad mar gyur nyid du// grub mdzad khyod kyi dgongs par ni// rnam 'grel mdzad pas bkral de yin// gzhal bya gnyis phyir tshad ma yang*// gnyis su nges gsungs khyod kho na// spyi mtshan sel ngor don dam du// bden kyang snang ngor kun rdzob kyi// bden phyir yod ma yin pas na// gzhal bya rang mtshan gcig kho nar// gsungs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rang mtshan la yang mngon gyur dang*// lkog gyur du nges gtan tshigs kyis// tshad ma gnyis las nyung ba dang*// der ma 'dus pa khyod mi bzhed// mngon sum rtogs bral ma 'khrul ba// 'chad pa khyod kyi lugs kho na// skabs 'dir zhen pa'i blo kho na// rtog par ngos 'dzin 'phral gyi ni// 'khrul rgyus ma bslad rig pa tsam// bshad mod rnam rig smra lugs la// yang dag min rtog dang bral zhing*// phugs kyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa// dgos par blo chen khyod kyis bzhed// tshad 'bras rnam gzhag tshig mang pos// bshad mod 'bras bu rang rig pas// gzhan med sgrub byed tshad ma yang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa las// gzhan bshad med do gzhal bya dang*// sbyor tshe rnam gzhag rnam pa bzhir// gsungs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhal bya don dang shes pa las// mang nyung med phyir 'jal byed kyang*// phyi nang lta ba gnyis byung med// dngos kyi gzhal bya rig pa las// gzhan med phyir na rang rig par// bsdu mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de tshe phyi rol don dag ni// yod par gang gis 'grub zer la// rgyu'i khyad par dpog pa yi// gtan tshigs mdo sde pas bshad tshe// rtags de mi mthun phyogs las ni// bzlog pa med par dmigs rtags su// gsungs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lhan cig dmigs nges gtan tshigs dang*// tshul gnyis sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i// rigs pas don smra rnams la ni// don rtogs sgrub byed yod min par// thag gcod mdzad nas rnam rig tu// grub mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rjes su dpag pa'i tshad ma la// rnam pa gnyis su dbye mdzad tshe// gzhal bya'i khyad par bsgrub bya dang*// sgrub byed tshul gsum gyis phye zhing*// gnyis ka 'jug yul gcig nyid la// rgyud nas 'brel phyir mi bslu ba// tshul gsum rang gis gang shes pa// gzhan la ston pa'i ming tshig gi

/tshogs su snang ba'i rnam rig kyang*// rjes su dpag pa'i tshad ma ste// de'i mtshan nyid tshang phyir ro// zhes pa'ang rnam rig smra gzhung du// gsungs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// smra mkhas khyod kyis gang bshad pa'i// bsgrub bya'i rnam gzhag rnam 'grel gyi// mdzad pos rgyas par bshad gyur kyang*// gangs can pa 'dis thams cad kyang*// phyin ci log tu bshad gzigs nas// don de tshul bzhin 'chad pa yi// rnam bshad 'ga' zhig phyis 'byung bar// byin gyis brlabs la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar de brtsams pa yis ni// dge ba mi zad mun 'joms shing*// snang byed 'od zer tshogs bkye bas// thub bstan nyin mor byed thob shog/ //shu bhaṃ// ༈ //dpal chos kyi grags pa'i rtogs brjod pad+ma dkar po'i phreng ba bzhugs so// ༄// na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ dpal phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba chos kyi grags pa'i zhal mnga' nas kyi rtogs pa brjod pa nges don pad+ma dkar po'i phreng bas rigs pa'i snang ba rgyas byed ces bya ba/ chos kyi nyi ma grub pa'i lang tsho can// nam yang grags pa'i khri la rab 'khod nas// rigs pa'i snang ba bgrang yas spro mkhas pa// rgyal bas lung bstan de la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi zla ba grags pa'i 'od dkar can// phyi rgol nub kyi ri brgya la dgongs nas// thub bstan shar gyi ri bo'i rtser 'char ba// mang pos phyag 'os de la phyag bgyi'o// rnam 'gyur mi 'dra'i rta brgyas drangs pa yi// lung dang rigs pa'i rab mnyam kha lo pas// gzhung lugs kun gyi lam srol ston mkhas pa// shing rta'i srol 'byed de la phyag bgyi'o// kun tu bzang po'i zhal gyi 'dzum phreng las// dal bur bab pa'i chos kyi sbu phreng ni// nye bar sim pa grags pa'i zlos gar mkhan// lung dang rigs pa'i lam du bde bar rgyu// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis phyogs kyi glang po la// legs 'doms rtog ge'i nyi ma cher 'bar ba// brtse chen khyod kyi rnam dpyod nam mkha' las// gzhan du gsal bar 'char ba'i skabs ma thob// sgrub dang sun 'byin rtsa ba 'brel ba dang*// de yang med na mi 'byung nges pa'i tshul// rtags gang mi mthun phyogs las bzlog pa ni// med na mi 'byung sgrub byed yin par gsungs// de ltar shes na rig byed bstan bcos bzhi// byed po dang bcas tshad ma min par grub// rig byed bden par sgrub ba'i gtan tshigs ni// mi mthun phyogs las bzlog pa med phyir ro// mngon lkog lung gis sgrub byed min bshad nas// shin lkog kho na dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i// lung gis 'grub tshul bshad pas rig byed dang*// ston pa'i bstan pa gnyis kyi khyad par phye// bcom ldan tshad mar sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs kyang*// rang don le'ur 'brel pa bshad pa la// rag las de phyir tshad ma grub pa yi// thog mar rang don rjes dpag khyod kyis bshad// tshad ma grub par snying rje chen po dang*// gang zag bdag med goms pa'i tshul bshad nas// mngon sum le'ur chos kyi bdag med ni// rgyas par bshad pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam// bdag chad smra ba'i 'jig rten rgyang 'phan ngor// rnam shes min pa rnam shes nyer len du// mi rigs rtags dang ha cang thal ba yi// rigs pas bde 'gro'i lam bzang gsal bar bstan// rtag par smra ba'i mu stegs rnams la ni// bdag yod smra dang thar pa khas len pa// 'gal bar bshad nas thar 'dod rnams la ni// bdag med lta ba grol ba'i lam du bshad// snying rje che dang bdag med lta ba yi// zung 'jug skye ba du mar goms pa las// de goms byed pa'i skye bo kun mkhyen du// 'byung rung sgrub pa'i rang bzhin gtan tshigs dang*// bde bar gshegs dang skyob pa'i gtan tshigs kyis// thugs rje che ldan ston pas sngon dus su// bsam sbyor phun tshogs nyams su bzhes so zhes// 'bras bu'i rtags kyis thub chen tshad mar bsgrubs// de ltar 'bras rang gtan tshigs rnam gnyis kyis// ston pa tshad mar bsgrubs nas bstan pa yang*// de nyid gshegs pa'i lam srol de yin par// dpyad gsum dag pa'i lung gis bsgrubs pa yin// tshad ma grub par kun mkhyen dngos stobs kyi// rigs pas bsgrubs zhes zer ba gad mo'i gnas// gzhal bya'i gnas gnyis dpyad pas ma dag par// shin lkog sgrub byed tshal ba 'dir mi bzhed// 'di yi khyab 'brel lung la rag las phyir// dngos stobs tshad mas 'grub pa'i go skabs med// dngos stobs zhes bya lung la ma ltos pa'i// yang dag rigs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs yin// gzhan du ma grags ldog pa gzhan sel gyi// rnam gzhag zhib mos gzhal bya'i chos rnams kun// rang spyi gnyis su nges par thag bcad nas// ldog pa'i chos rnams rtog pas sgro btags shing*// rags rgyun dngos po btags yod yin pa'i phyir// spyi mtshan chos rnams bden par med do zhes// mdo sde smra ba'i lugs dang thun mong du// chos kyi bdag med sgo chen dang por phye// mngon sum don la bsnyon pa med grags kyang*// mngon sum blo yis phyi rol don grub dang*// ldog pa'i chos dang rags rgyun dngos po rnams// rtog med blo yis bzung bar 'chad pa sogs// rang gzhan sde pa'i log pa'i blo gros kyis// mngon sum yul la rnam btags mang gzigs nas// mngon gyur don yang rigs pa'i lam nyid du// legs par drangs nas 'chad mkhas khyod kho na// mngon gyur grags pas 'jog pa gzhan gyi lugs// de nas phyi rol don dang don snang gi

/rnam pa bden med bsgrubs nas gnyis med kyi// ye shes de nyid don dam yin zhes pa// mngon sum le'ur bshad pa'i nges don yin// don snang shes la gang snang don yin zhes// 'jig rten blun po'i blo gros kyis brtags shing*// bye brag smra ba'i gzhung gis de bzung nas// rten bcas dbang pos phyi don rtogs shes 'chad// gsal zhing rig dang tshul gnyis sgrub rigs kyis// gang snang de kun sems su rab bsgrubs nas// don snang shes pas don dngos mi 'dzin pa'i// rnam bcas tshul de'ang chos kyi bdag med sgo// don snang res 'ga' skye ba'i gtan tshigs kyis// don yod ces pa mdo sde smra ba'i gzhung*// bag chags sad dang gcig dang du bral gyi// rigs pas gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan thog mar bkag /gzung ba med na de 'dzin med pa dang*// gcig dang du mar med pa'i gtan tshigs kyis// gzung rnam bden med yin par legs grub nas// gzung 'dzin gnyis stong tshul de bar du bshad// gnyis med ye shes kho na chos kun gyi// de bzhin nyid dang 'gyur med yongs grub dang*// yang dag mtha' dang chos kyi dbyings dang ni// don dam yin zhes khyod kyis tha mar bshad// tshul gnyis pa dang rang rig sgrub byed kyi// rigs pas don snang rnam bcas grub pa na// phyi don rtogs pa'i mngon sum mi bzhed kyang*// rtags kyis bsgrubs nas phyir lta'i shes pa kun// rang rig yin tshul bshad pa'i mdo sde pa'i// grub mtha'i rtsa ba bsdus par khyod kyis bshad// bag chags blo dang snang rung ma dmigs pa'i// rtags kyis phyi don bkag nas de 'dzin gyi// rnam pa'ang dngos por med pa'i tshul 'chad pa// rnam rig smra ba'i grub pa'i rtsa bar gsungs// de ltar bdag med gnyis kyi lta ba ni// rang gis rtogs bzhin gzhan la bstan bya'i phyir// sgrub pa'i ngag dang bsgrub bya'i skyon rnam gnyis// ji ltar sel tshul gzhan don le'ur bshad// tshul gsum tshad ma'i lam du bstan byas nas// bsgrub bya'i don de ngag tu mi brjod par// rtags tshig gsal bar bsnyad pas dam bca'i don// rtogs pa'i rjes dpag bskyed pa sgrub pa'i ngag

/rang phyogs thal bas grub cing ma grub pa'i// sgrub byed bkod nas slar yang de sgrub pa'i// shes byed rim par bkod pa'i phreng ba yis// tha mar grub don med 'di khyod gzhung min// rang rgyud 'god pa'i rgol ba de dag kyang*// rtags kyi tsher ma dbyung ba'i ming tsam yang*// med par dam bcas tshig zin brjod pa yi// sbyor ba'i 'god tshul khyod kyi gzhung dang 'gal// gzhan gyi khas blangs rtags su sbyar byas nas// rtags chos 'brel pa tshad mas 'grub nges la// thal ba'i chos gang tshad mas bsal gyur pa// 'khor gsum tshang ba'i thal 'gyur yin par bzhed// rtags la khas blangs med na khyab chos tsam// khas blangs yin kyang thal 'gyur du mi rung*// dngos stobs yul la khas blangs 'gal ba tsam// phan tshun gegs byed yin par khyod kyis bshad// gzhan phyogs 'gog tshe rjes dpag bskyed pa dang*// log rtog sel ba'i tshul de mi sems par// khas blangs 'gal ba 'dus tsam rgyal pham gyi// tshad du 'jog pa khyod kyi gzhung dang 'gal// rtags kyis sgrub mi nus pa bsgrub bya yi// skyon zhes deng sang 'di na mthun par smra// rtags dang bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid de dag gi /gsal bya so sor nges pa khyod kyi bshad// dam bca' yang dag yin na zhen pa'i don// smra bo'i tshad mas grub ces 'di na smra// bsgrub par bya dang dam bca'i zhen don la// grub gsal med cing dpag 'dod dgos par bshad// ma dmigs gtan tshigs gang yin dgag pa yi// ga tshigs yin zhes 'di na kun gyis smra// snang rung ma dmigs gtso bo sgrub pa yi// gtan tshigs yin par smra mkhas khyod kyis bshad// chen por grags rnams sde bdun mdzad pa'i gzhung*// ngo bo nyid med smra ba'i gzhung du 'chad// klu sgrub zhabs dang thogs med bzhed gzhung la// mi mthun med par smra mchog 'di bzhed mod// thal rang lung dang mthun pa'i dbu ma ni// gang 'di'i gzhung chen de dang der mi 'byung*// de phyir tshul 'di rnal 'byor spyod gzhung gi

/dbu ma'i lugs der gdon mi 'tshal ba yin// de yang theg chen mdo sde'i rgyan dang ni// mtha' dbus sel ba'i bstan bcos rnam gnyis su// sher phyin mdo don dbu mar 'grel ba'i tshul// ji skad gsungs de phyogs kyi glang pos bzhed// 'di la bod rnams sems tsam rnam brdzun zer// rnam brdzun bzhed kyang sems tsam don mi gnas// don dam ye shes yin par bzhed gyur kyang*// kun rdzob sems tsam nyid du zhal mi bzhes// sems dang sems byung yang dag min rtog gi /dbye bar 'chad pa rje btsun byams pa'i gzhung*// ye shes gang yin sems dang sems byung du// bshad na theg chen bsdus pa'i lung dang 'gal// rnam shes ye shes so sor dbye ba ni// 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo sde dang*// dbyig gnyen zhabs kyi mdo sde'i rgyan 'grel dang*// tshigs bcad sum cu'i rab tu byed par bshad// rdzogs sangs rgyas la sems dang sems byung gi /rgyu ba 'dod na mdo sde'i rgyan gzhung dang*// rnal 'byor spyod gzhung theg chen bsdus pa las// tshogs brgyad gnas gyur bshad pa ji ltar drang*// gnas gyur nas kyang de der khas len na// rdzogs sangs rgyas la kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang*// 'byung las gyur pa'i dbang po rnam lnga dang*// nyon mongs can yid yod par khas long shig /bdag nyid che khyod kun gzhi mi bzhed ces// deng sang 'di na mang po'i mgrin par gleng*// kun gzhi med na thogs med bzhed gzhung gi /shing rta'i srol gyi lam chen 'dzin mi nus// mthar thug theg gcig 'chad pa'i gsal kha ni// gzhung 'dir med mod 'on kyang dgra bcom pa// tha ma'i sems kyis sems gzhan mtshams sbyor bar// bshad pa de yis de don bsgrubs kyang rung*// de ltar 'chad tshe lhag bcas dgra bcom nas// theg chen lam du zhugs tshe sngon gyi lus// de nyid dbang po'i lus su byin rlob ces// rnam par gtan dbab bsdu ba'i lung du bshad// lhag med dbyings nas theg chen lam 'jug pa// mdo sde'i rgyan sogs rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung*// rang sor gzhag tshe gsal bar ma gsungs mod// thogs med zhabs kyis theg chen rgyud bla ma// nges don snying por bkral tshe sangs rgyas las// gzhan la myang 'das med pa'i shes byed kyis// lhag med dbyings nas sems mchog bskyed par gsungs// de tshe dpal phreng mdo yi rjes 'brangs nas// ma rig bag chags sa dang zag med kyi// las kyi lus gzhan brgyud mar blangs nas ni// byang chub mchog tu rdzogs sangs rgya bar gsungs// thogs med zhabs kyi dbu ma'i tshul lugs 'dir// lta ba'i rnam gzhag phyogs kyi glang po yi// sher phyin bsdus par bshad las gzhan med kyang*// mthar thug theg gcig tshul de gsal bar bshad// gnyis med ye shes bden par bzhed gyur kyang*// bden 'dzin lta ci mtshan 'dzin phra mo yang*// spang byar bstan nas thams cad mkhyen pa yi// go 'phang bla na med de thob byar bshad// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis phyogs kyi glang po la// gang 'doms rigs pa'i srol chen zla med pa// gsal bar bshad nas thogs med bzhed gzhung gi

/nges don 'chad mkhas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// drang don rtog ge'i lus brgyad 'dis ni gzhung lugs mtha' dag rigs pa'i lam du drang*// nges don gnyis med ye shes 'di yang dpal ldan grags pa'i dgongs don snying por nges// sgo brgya 'byed pa'i lde mig 'di yis ma phyed gzhan med de yang chos kyi sgo// cig char mun sel rigs pas bstod 'dis bdag kyang rigs pa smra ba nyid gyur cig /ces dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs kyi rigs pa'i sbrang rtsi mtshar pos/ rnam dpyod kyi ro 'dzin gshin por byas pa'i klog pa pa/ mi pham dges pa'i bshes gnyen gyis dge bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //shu bhaṃ mastu// // ༄༅// swasti/ 'phags pa yon tan 'od mdzad kyi rtogs brjod ces bya ba/ de nyid kyi gsung rab la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// bram ze'i rigs las rab byung ba// gang gi yon tan sa gsum pa// 'od byed po la bzhugs bzhin du// gzhung lugs 'bum phrag bco brgyad tsam// thugs la byon nas zhal 'don du// mdzad la thogs pa mi mnga' zhes// sa stengs chen por grags 'ga' yis// snyan par bsgrags la phyag 'tshal lo// sa phyogs gang na ston pa'i 'khor// rnam bzhi gang na yod gyur pa// de na bstan pa'i rtsa ba ni// bzhugs zhes tshad ldan gzhung las gsungs// dge bsnyen pha mas bstan pa yi// zhabs nas 'degs so dge slong dag /'dus par gyur pas 'dul ba yi// bstan pa rdzogs gsal 'dzin par nus// dge tshul tshogs rnams khyim pa yi// phyag 'os bstan pa'i gdung 'tshob pa// gyur kyang 'dul bar rtogs mtha' dag /mi 'dzin bla ma'i bya bas ngal// 'dus rnams tshul khrims ma 'khrul ba// nyid dang las kyi cho ga'i tshogs// zhal nas rdzogs par thon nus pa// med na thub bstan mi 'byung bar// gsung mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khrims ldan 'dul ba mi 'dzin dang*// zung 'brel dkon pa'i mtha' 'khob tu// re re yang ni bstan 'dzin du// bsngags mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khrims ldan sde snod mi 'dzin na// sde snod 'dzin pa khrims 'chal yang*// rgyang ring bskrad par mi bya zhes// gsungs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// kha skongs yan lag 'dul ba yi// bslab sbyangs kun rdzogs min mod kyang*// bstan pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po// de med gzhan gyis bsrung mi nus// mu stegs skrag byed seng ge'i bu// 'di las gzhan pa gang zhig tshol// tshogs pa'i nang du las res dang*// chad pa'i las kyi mi 'jigs shing*// ltung las ldang ba yang ba dang*// ltung bar gyur kyang lci min pas// sde snod 'dzin pa mchog nyid du// gces pa yin no de las kyang*// kha skong yan lag tshang tsam zhig

/thog mar dge 'di med mi rung*// bstan pa nub la thug gyur na// gnas ster nus pa khyim pa dang*// mkhan po bstan med nyid kyang ni// rung ba khyod kyi gzhung las 'byung*// 'dul ba 'dzin la gces spras su// bya bar gsungs pas sangs rgyas kyi// zhal nas gsungs pa'i so thar dang*// las brgya tshig tu thon la dgongs// gnas ster nus la de tsam yang*// dgos pa min par lnga phrugs kyi// lhan cig sbyar ba'i gzhung mdzad pas// gsal bar rtogs la phyag 'tshal lo// dge slong re re'i 'khor dag tu// dge tshul gcig las mi lhag cing*// dge tshul re yang dge slong la// nges par brten zhes khyod kyis gsungs// dge tshul rkyang pa'i tshogs kyi ni// dge 'dun sde bzung 'dir mi srid// dge slong rkyang pa'i tshogs kyi ni// de 'dzin nus so de yi tshe// dge bsnyen med mi rung yin phyir// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi 'khor bzhi po// tshang ba med du mi rung bar// gsung mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtha' gnyis bsal nas so thar gyi// bstan pa 'dzin nus dgon pa ni// kho nar gnas dgos ma yin pas// grong khyer dbus kyi gtsug lag khang*// sde tshan mi 'dra mang po yang*// mtshams chen gcig gi bskor nang du// dbyar gnas kyis mtshon bya rung bar// gsungs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zla ba gsum du dbyar gnas par// khas blangs pa ni dpag bsam gyi// ljon shing dang ni yid bzhin gyi// nor bu lta bur 'di na dge /dbyar gyi rnyed pa bde blag tu// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung las dang*// gnas mal dang ni gnas rnyed dang*// chos gos tshegs yod min pa dang*// 'phral du mi rtsod phyi mthar yang*// rtsod pa'i rgyu rnams zhi bar byed// dgag dbye bsra brkyang dbyar gnas pa// med par mi 'byung de yod las// de 'byung dpag bsam shing lta bur// gsungs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gso sbyong dus kyi sta gon du// sngar yod ltung ba phyir 'chos pa// med du mi rung de de ltar// mi nus na yang 'don pa lnga// so so'i skabs su de mthol ba// nges par dgos pa de nas ni// phyir 'chos pa la bde blag tu// 'jug phyir nya shi'i gso sbyong ni// ltung las ldang byed thabs mchog tu// gsungs mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshams chen bcad pas las so so'i// sgrub byed kyis ni gang sgrub tshe// 'dul ba 'dzin pa gcig gis kyang*// khyab che de rnyed sla ba dang*// mi 'bral snang ba 'chags pa dang*// dge 'dun dbyen gyi rgyu tshogs pa// 'byung rung mtha' dag khegs pa dang*// sa gzhan gnas pa'i chad pa can// kun kyang mtshams las mi 'da' bar// byed par dgongs la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshams chung mang po'i mtshams chen gyi// skor la dgos pa de dang de// kho nar ma zad la la'i dus// khyab chen las la 'jug ka'i tshe// so so'i dkyil 'khor pa dag tu// dge 'dun las kyi bye brag can// dmigs kyis bsal rnams gegs med par// grub pa nyid phyir lus dang sems// bde bar gnas mdzad la phyag 'tshal// bde bar gnas rkyen gtsug lag khang*// stan dang dmigs bsal ma gsungs pa'i// rdzas nor mang po dag la yang*// byin rlob 'bad rtsol mi dgos par// gos dang sman la tshad dang ni// byin rlabs ji ltar longs spyod tshul// gnang bas tshul khrims bsrung mdzad rnams// bde bar 'tsho la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar de brtsams pa las ni// byung ba'i mchod phreng dri zhim pa// tsan+dan sa mchog ltar dge ba// 'gro la ring du gnas par shog/

//shubhaṃ// ༄༅// swasti/ bsnyengs bral zla ba grags pa'i zhabs kyi rtogs pa brjod nas zhu ba'i phrin yig bden brdzun gyi shan rnam par 'byed pa nges don gtam gyi rol mo 'dren pa'i ngag gi shing lta zhes bya ba/

ye shes kyis/ don dam gzigs pa'i cha shas ma nyams shing*/ 'jig rten la/ /kun rdzob grags pa'i 'od dkar ma 'gribs par// rten 'brel nam mkha'i lam la lham me ba// zla ba grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// kun rdzob chos lugs 'jig rten gzhung bzhin du// 'khrul 'khor/ zhal gyis bzhes nas bsod nams tshogs mang pos// 'gro kun phan bde'i lam du 'dren brtson pa'i// shing rta'i srol 'byed khyod la phyag bgyi'o// don dam chos tshul gnas skabs dbu ma'i/ grub mtha'i gzhung ji bzhin// rigs par bshad nas mthar thug srid zhi'i rtog pa kun// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa'i lam chen por// bde bar 'dren mdzad khyod la phyag bgyi'o// blang dor ji snyed rnam shes yul gyi chos// ye shes yul du ngo bos stong pa'i tshul// mi 'gal don gcig 'du ba zung 'jug gi /lam du ston mdzad khyod la phyag bgyi'o// chos kun gdod nas yod ma myong ba na// rtag dang chad pa'i mtha' las grol lo zhes// dbu ma'i lam nas mthar 'dzin gzhil mdzad pa'i// mtha' bral gsung ba de la phyag bgyi'o// chos kun rang rang ngo bos stong pa la// spros pa'i mtshan ma ye shes kyi ngor/ ci yang mi gzigs par/ rnam shes kyi ngor /rten dang ltos pa'i rten 'brel gsung ba la// 'jigs med smra mkhas khyod la 'di springs so// khyod gzhung 'chad mkhas nyin byed nub pa na// grags 'dod khur gyis ngal ba'i khyab 'jug gis// rnam dpyod 'khyog po'i lag pa ring brkyang nas// nyid gzhung 'od ris bsgribs pa yin snyam byed// 'chad rtsom nyi zla'i mig yangs rnam dpyod kyi// gdong mdzes ltar ba'i kun gsal lang tsho yis// spobs pa'i go skabs yangs par phye ba na// zla bar grags gzhung bde bar rgyu min nam// 'gro kun bsod nams lam du 'jug pa na// 'jig rten gzhung dang mthun par khyod kyis bshad// lhan skyes 'khrul pas btags

rnam dam dang bden grub/ pa gang gang la// yod med 'dor len byed par khyod bzhed dam// 'jig rten lugs kyi don dam ji snyed pa// tha snyad bden pa'i mtshan gzhir khyod kyis bshad// lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas brtags pa'i/ bdag dang bden grub tha snyad du yang med pas kun rdzob bden pa min zhes bden pa yang*// khas len min pa khyod kyi kun rdzob bden pa 'jog pa'i/ gzhung yin nam// mu stegs kyis brtags bdag dang bden pa sogs/ ye shes gnyid kyis rab bskyod mu stegs can 'dogs/ /'jig rten gzhung gi kun rdzob bden par bshad// 'jig rten dang rnal 'byor pa'i yang log gi kun rdzob bden pa'i rnam grangs ji snyed pa// thams cad mkhyen blos gzigs la khyod bzhed dam// 'jig rten lugs kyi kun rdzob dang don dam gyi/ bden pa gnyis po la// yang log kun rdzob ces byar khyod kyis bshad/ thal 'gyur ba yang dag kun rdzob mi 'dod ces/ /kun rdzob gang yin log pa'i kun rdzob tu// 'chad pa de yang khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// 'jig rten lugs dang dbu ma'i gzhung dag tu// kun rdzob gang yin 'khrul pa'i snang bar mthong ba rdzun pa'ang kun rdzob bden par gsungs zhes/ bshad// thams cad mkhyen blo'i yul du kun rdzob kun// rang snang tshul gyis mkhyen par khyod bzhed dam// gnyid sad blo la rmi lam ji bzhin du// rdzogs sangs rgyas blor yul snang med ces gsungs// thams cad mkhyen blos gzigs pa log gyur na// tha snyad yul du'ang med par khyod bzhed dam// bden dang sgyu ma snang med ces bya ba'i// kun rdzob shes tshul rnam gsum khyod kyi bshad/ par/ sad par gyur na gsum car yod min ltar/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la kun rdzob snang zhes pa// klu sgrub gzhung lugs yin par khyod bzhed dam// bden tshad ma rnam nges kyi lung gis rang lugs sgrub par// des gang bcos ma bden par snang de ni/

ces sogs/ brdzun khyad par tshad ma'i lam du ni// yod dang med la 'chad par gal te 'jig rten tshad ma yin na ni/ 'jig rten de nyid mthong bas 'phags gzhan gyis/ ci dgos 'phags pa'i lam gyis ci zhig bya/ 'jig rten lugs kyi tshad mas tshad ma'i go chod par byas nas/ khyod kyis bshad// kun rdzob tshad ma'i yul na yod bzhin du// rdzun par 'chad pa khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// kun rdzob rdzun zhing mya ngan 'das gcig pu// bden par 'chad pa khyod kyi gnas skabs lugs// bden gnyis rang lugs 'phags pa'i/ tshad mas grub mnyam du// khyod gnyis ka'ang rang lugs la bden pa tsam yin zhes/ kyis bshad pa'i gnas skabs yod dam ci// mdo sems la sogs rang gi grub pa'i mthas// rnam par brtags nas tha snyad bden par 'jog /khyod kyis 'jig rten gzhung la ma brten par// kun rdzob bden pa dbu ma rang lugs kyi tshad mas grub bo zhes/ tha snyad bden pa'i 'jog lugs ji ltar bzhed// tha snyad 'jog pa'i tshad ma ji snyed pa// dbu ma'i gzhung gi blun po tshad mar rig pa ma yin no// zhes/ tshad ma min par bshad// don smra ba la grags pa'i dbang mngon sogs/ gnyis snang 'khrul pas bslad pa'i shes pa yang*// tshad mar 'chad pa khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// dbu ma'i grub mthar bar du bdag zlog pa'i rigs pa/ zhugs nas kun rdzob chos// rang rang ngo bos stong par khyod kyis bshad// mig dang gzugs sogs rang rang yin zhes pa// dbu ma'i gzhung lugs yin par khyod bzhed dam// ji srid don dam bden pa khas len pa// de srid de mtshan gzhi don dam pa'i bden par khas len dgos pas/ de rang stong min par bshad// bum pa'i chos nyid/ don dam pa yin pa/ bden dang ngo bos stong zhes pa// gzhi gcig 'du ba bden pa dang rang stong 'gal bas/ khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// chos kun spros dang bral bar 'chad pa na// don dam bden pa'i mtshan gzhi khyod mi bzhed// mtha' bral de nyid don dam bden no zhes// khas len byed pa khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// dngos kun de nyid de yis stong pa gang*// rang stong zhes bya'i don du khyod kyis

gang phyir de yi rang bzhin de// yin phyir mig ni mig gis stong*// zhes sogs/ bshad// rang rang de nyid yin par khas blangs nas// rang stong 'dod pa khyod kyi bzhed yin nam// bum pa bum pa min zhes khas len pas/ de nyid de yi ngo bos mi stong ba// tha snyad bden pa'i 'jog tshul yin par bshad// kun rdzob tu yang chos kun rang bzhin gyis// stong zhes 'chad pa las 'bras rnams la sems pa'ang dgag pa mdzad// zhes/ khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// rigs drug so so'i yul snang ji snyed pa// chu 'bab skra klung la zhes sogs/ shad 'dzin blo'i yul dang mtshungs par bshad// phyi rol gyi don yod par khas blangs nas chu dang brnag sogs/ gang snang de kun yod pa khyod gzhung gi /tha snyad bden pa'i 'jog tshul yin nam ci// gang gi btags don 'tshol ba'i rigs pa yis// ma rnyed pa de bden med tshad du bshad// bden med nges pa'i thog mar bden grub tshad// ston dgos shes pa khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// bden grub dang bden med gnyis las phyi ma nges sla ba'i shes byed ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i dpe dang shes byed kyi// gtan tshigs yod phyir gzhan la bstan par sla// rang bzhin sgrub pa'i dpe dang shes byed kyi// gtan tshigs med phyir bsnyad bya min zhes gsungs// mtha' bral dpyod tshe kun rdzob lta ci 'tshal// don dam dam bca' med par khyod kyis bshad// gzhan gsung bkag nas rang gzhung sgrub pa ni// mtha' bral chen po'i 'chad tshul du bzhed dam// bum sogs rang rang yin par khas blangs nas/ chos kun rang rang ngo bos mi stong ba// rang stong zhes bya'i don du khyod mi bzhed// de des mi stong bar gzhan bden grub kyis stong zhes/ tshad grub chos rnams tshad mas ma grub pa'i// bden pas stong pa gzhan stong tshul min nam// bdag dang shing rta'i 'dogs tshul mtshungs bshad nas// de nyid des stong bdag med gnyis kyi don// yin par bshad mod bdag dang shing rta gnyis// yod

tshad mas grub/ mnyam 'chad pa khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// chos dang gang zag de nyid kyis stong pa// bdag med gnyis po'i don du khyod kyis bshad// khyod chos bden med/ gcig pu chos can so so yis// rnam par dbye ba khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// gzhi dang rtags dpe gzhan gyis khas blangs pa// gzhan grags zhes bya'i don du khyod kyis bshad// tshul gsum tshad mas grub pa gzhan grags kyi// don du 'chad pa khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// don dam dpyod tshe bsgrub bya bsgrub pa ni// rang rgyud rtags kyi dam bcar khyod kyis bshad// dgag bya 'gog dang bsgrub bya bsgrub pa gnyis// don gcig 'du ba khyod kyi gzhung yin nam// sems dang sems byung ji snyed gnyis snang gi /bag chags 'khrul pa'i snang bar khyod kyis bshad// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang sems dang sems byung gi /rgyu bas chos kun gzigs par khyod bzhed dam// dbu mar zhugs nas ye shes la rton gyi// rnam par shes la yid rton med par tshig gsal du/ bshad// 'phags pa'i mkhyen blo yid kyi rnam shes su// 'chad pa de yang khyod kyi gzhung ye shes thams cad kyang de gnyis su 'tshor bcad nas/ yin nam// thub pa'i dam chos ston tshul rnam gsum las// dang por bdag dang bar du bdag med dag /nges bstan tha mar khas len med ces pa// khyod kyi nges don 'chad pa'i man ngag yin// thog mar kun rdzob kyi bden pa 'jog pa'i tshe/ bden grub ming yang mi 'dod cing*// don dam bden pa khas len pa'i tshe/ bar du bden grub khas mi len par/ bden med ngo bos stong pa dang*// tha mar spros bral 'chad pa'i tshe'ang*/ chos kun yod par khas len pa// grags dkar khyod kyi gzhung lugs min snyam byed// mnyam gzhag tshe na chos kun stong ngo zhes// yid byed de 'dra lta ba'i dug tu bshad// bden pas stong zhes yid kyis ma bzung na//

bden 'dzin dang 'dzin stangs mi 'gal zhes/ spros bral rtogs blo min par khyod bzhed dam// dngos gzhi'i tshe na sor rtog shes rab kyang*// shing gnyis drud pa las 'byung ba'i dpes/ ye shes me yis bsreg byar khyod kyis bshad// yang yang sems dang 'jal dang nges rtog pa// mnyam gzhag dngos gzhir grags dkar khyod bzhed dam// klu sgrub bzhed gzhung spros pa'i mtha' bral ba// thogs med dang chos skyong sogs/ srol 'byed gzhan gyi lam nas ma drangs par// chos kun rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i tshul// gsal bar 'doms mkhas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid gzhung ji bzhin bshad na kun gyi blor mi shong*// gzhan zer de nyid smas na khyod gzhung 'jig par dogs// mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin nam khyod gzhung nyid 'chad ces// mkhyen bzang zla ba grags dkar ldan pa la springs so// zla ba'i gzhung lugs nges don cha shas mdzod// rang bzo'i sgra gcan gyis zos rnam brtags pas// gang nas bsgribs de thog mar bsal gyur nas// 'od dkar snang bas khyod gzhung mdzes byed shog /gangs can 'di na grags pa gsal ldan 'gas// zla gzhung shing rta 'khyog por drangs mthong nas// mtha' gnyis sel ba'i rab mnyam kha lo pas// nges don lam du drangs pa mi mtshar ram// zhes dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i zhal mnga' nas kyi nges don gyi rnga sgras/ blo gros kyi khang bzang dge bar byas pa'i spong ba pa/ 'jam dpal dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis nye bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan no// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
